stem:
Kian leaves one iron nail in a dry sealed jar of air. He leaves a second iron nail half in water open to air. He also has a third iron nail coated with brown paint.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The nail half in open water can rust because air and water both reach the iron.
The brown paint on the third nail can help prevent rust by blocking air and water from the iron.
The nail in the dry sealed jar of air will rust because air alone is enough.
The brown paint on the third nail is itself rust.

teacher.key_rationale: Rusting of iron needs both air and water. The open wet nail can rust; a dry air-only jar does not supply water. Paint blocks contact and is not rust.
